The maximum number of member accounts that can be associated with a GuardDuty administrator account by invitation.

Your current AWS Organizations member account quota shows the default maximum number of member accounts that you can associate with an administrator through AWS Organizations, including members added by invitation. The number of GuardDuty member accounts added through AWS Organizations can't exceed the total member accounts in your organization.
